action_definitions.STOP: Do not make another qualifying attempt.
action_definitions.REATTEMPT: Make another attempt when there is no currently protected valid result that must be retained or withdrawn.
action_definitions.RETAIN_AND_REATTEMPT: Retain the current valid result while entering a non-priority reattempt path.
action_definitions.WITHDRAW_AND_REATTEMPT: Withdraw the currently protected valid result before making another attempt.
action_definitions.WITHDRAW_AND_PRIORITY_REATTEMPT: Withdraw the current result and enter the priority reattempt path.

critical_rule: REATTEMPT and WITHDRAW_AND_REATTEMPT must remain distinct. A car already outside the field with no protected result cannot be labelled as withdrawing a result before reattempting.
